log_files.description: Glob pattern(s) or path(s) to PostgreSQL log files to analyze.

out_dir.description: Directory where the HTML report will be written.

output_filename.description: Base filename for the output report. Not used in incremental mode.

top_queries.description: Number of queries to store/display in the report.

query_samples.description: Number of query samples to store.

average_graphs_minutes.description: Number of minutes to build the average graphs of queries and connections.

histo_average_minutes.description: Number of minutes to build the histogram graphs of queries.

log_format.description: Log format (syslog, syslog2, stderr, jsonlog, csv, pgbouncer, logplex, rds, redshift). Empty for autodetect.

log_prefix.description: Custom log_line_prefix value. Empty to use autodetect or standard.

incremental.description: Enable incremental mode to generate daily/weekly reports.

retention_weeks.description: Number of weeks to keep in incremental mode. 0 disables retention cleanup.

jobs_per_file.description: Number of jobs to run at same time for a single log file.

jobs_parallel.description: Number of log files to parse in parallel.

exclude_queries.description: List of regex patterns to exclude queries from the report.

exclude_databases.description: List of database names to exclude from the report.

exclude_users.description: List of usernames to exclude from the report.

exclude_clients.description: List of client IPs to exclude from the report.

disable_query.description: Disable query reports (slowest, most frequent, etc.).

disable_error.description: Do not generate the error report.

anonymize.description: Obscure all literals in queries to hide confidential data.

report_title.description: Title of the HTML page report.

timezone_offset.description: Timezone offset (+/-XX) to adjust dates/times in JavaScript graphs. Empty to use default.

quiet.description: Don't print anything to stdout, not even a progress bar.
